Noise,Ⓒs.Ⓓni-, nAdaH, DvaniH, SabdaH, ni-, svanaH, GozaH, mahA-ucca-svaraH, utkroSaH, vi-, rAvaH, ravaH, nihrAdaH; ‘rattling n(oise)’ raRitaM, raRa-tkAraH; ‘jingling n(oise)’ kvaRaH, kvaRanaM, kvaRitaM; ‘loud n(oise)’ kalakalaH, kolAhalaH, tumulaM, mahASabdaH-svanaH-GozaH.
Ⓑ
 2 janaravaH-pravAdaH-Sruti f.; ‘make n(oise)’ nad 1 P, Dvan 1 P, vi-, ru 2 P, raR 1 P, SabdAyate (D.), kolAhalaM-kalakalaM-kf 8 U; ‘shallow water makes great n(oise)’ arDo Gawo Gozamu-pEti nUnaM.

Ⓝ[Noise]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹsaSabda; See Noisy, below.
Ⓝ[Noise]less,Ⓒa.ⒹniHSabda, nIrava, nirGoza.

 2 ninAda-pUrita, kalakalavyApta, muKara, saSabda, nAdin, saM-ni-hrAdin.

Ⓝ[Nois]iness,Ⓒs.ⒹmahASabdaH-DvaniH.

Noisome,Ⓒa.ⒹdurgaMDa, pUtigaMDi, kutsita, duzwa, samala.

 2 mAraka, mArAtmaka, kzayakara (rI f.), nASAvaha, GAtuka, bADaka.
